dedupe_keys.name: symba project database of industrial symbiosis solutions in europe

description: This database compiles the industrial symbiosis mapping done for deliverable D3.1 of the SYMBA project, a report on current industrial symbiosis solutions in Europe. The spreadsheet read on 2026-09-26 has about 1,950 rows with category, solution name, project type (for example EU-funded or case study), level, country, region, dates, exchanged flows (secondary raw materials, waste, renewable energy, residual heat, gas emissions, water, biological feedstocks, agri-food, metals, plastics, textiles), industrial sector, a description and a reference. It was published in December 2024 by the SYMBA project team under the CC BY 4.0 licence, free to download as one Excel file. Coverage is mainly Europe. Caveats: many cells are NA, entries are compiled from project pages and reports, not verified exchanges, and there are no coordinates. For simulation it gives documented residual heat, by-product and water exchanges between plants to build industrial symbiosis and interdependency networks. Related catalogue records include the MAESTRI library of industrial symbiosis case studies and the international dataset on eco-innovation parks.
